mapper.select: SELECT id,username,xianyu_id, ROUND( ST_Distance_Sphere( location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{latitude}, ' ', #{longitude}, ')'), 4326) ) / 1000, 1 ) AS distance_km, ST_Distance_Sphere( location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{latitude}, ' ', #{longitude}, ')'), 4326) ) AS distance_meters FROM user WHERE id != #{id} AND location IS NOT NULL AND ST_Distance_Sphere(location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{latitude}, ' ', #{longitude}, ')'), 4326)) <= 30000 ORDER BY distance_meters ASC
